# Third-party assets

These distributions are served locally so core UI rendering does not depend on a CDN. Preserve their embedded copyright and license notices when updating them.

- Vue: `https://unpkg.com/vue@3/dist/vue.global.prod.js` (version is recorded in the file banner).
- GSAP and ScrollTrigger 3.12.5: `https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/gsap/3.12.5/`.
- Leaflet 1.9.4 and its images: `https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/`.
- Font Awesome Free 6.0.0-beta3 CSS and WOFF2 fonts: `https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/6.0.0-beta3/`.

Tailwind CSS is compiled locally using the version locked in the root `package-lock.json`.
